# Lisbon 5-Day Trip Plan: Sep 10–14, 2025

A single-hotel stay works well in Lisbon, and this plan keeps each day walkable with museum time, seafood meals, and neighborhood clustering. Budget target: **€1,800 total for 2 adults, excluding flights**.

## Day-by-Day Lisbon Itinerary
| Day | Focus | Morning | Afternoon | Evening | Est. Spend |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sep 10 | Baixa + Chiado | Arrive, check in, Praça do Comércio stroll | Lisbon Story Centre or MUDE, café break in Chiado | Seafood dinner in Cais do Sodré | €260 |
| Sep 11 | Alfama + Castelo | Tram/walk through Alfama, Lisbon Cathedral area | Castelo de São Jorge, Fado museum or viewpoint stop | Sunset dinner near Miradouro de Santa Luzia | €290 |
| Sep 12 | Belém | Jerónimos Monastery, Belém Tower exterior | MAAT or Coach Museum, riverside walk | Pasteis de Belém + relaxed dinner | €320 |
| Sep 13 | Bairro Alto + Príncipe Real | Museum morning: National Museum of Ancient Art | Garden stroll, boutiques, Miradouro São Pedro de Alcântara | Seafood/tapas in Bairro Alto | €270 |
| Sep 14 | Parque das Nações or easy final day | Oceanário or riverside walk | Last shopping, lunch, hotel pickup | Depart or final dinner if timing allows | €220 |

## Neighborhood Map View
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg

- **Baixa / Chiado**: best for first-day orientation, shopping, cafés, and easy walking.
- **Alfama / Castelo**: historic lanes, viewpoints, Fado atmosphere, and classic Lisbon character.
- **Belém**: museum-heavy and ideal for a half-day or full-day culture route.
- **Bairro Alto / Príncipe Real**: museums, gardens, dining, and evening energy.
- **Parque das Nações**: modern waterfront area, good for a calmer final day.

## Spending Chart Idea
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/currency-euro.svg

Use a simple bar chart with:
- **X-axis:** Day 1 to Day 5
- **Y-axis:** Estimated spend in EUR
- **Bars:** 260, 290, 320, 270, 220
- **Goal line:** €1,800 total trip budget
- **Interpretation:** Keep higher-spend museum/heavy sightseeing days balanced by lighter final-day spending

## Budget Fit for 2 Adults
- **Planned total:** **€1,360**
- **Buffer remaining:** **€440**
- Good uses for buffer:
  - better seafood dinner
  - tram/taxi rides on steep days
  - museum tickets
  - one upgraded lunch or wine tasting
